noAccess: You do not have access to complaints in this call centre.
title: Complaints
intro: Fetch the call the complaint is about with the reference from the sales system. The case brings together the recording, transcript and note; the AI assesses the complaint against the call and drafts a reply.
limit: Showing the first 200. Use the filter to find more.

lookup.title: Fetch a case by call reference
lookup.intro: Enter the reference the seller pasted into the sales system, for example VQ-7K3M-Q9TX. You only find calls you have access to.
lookup.label: Reference
lookup.none: No complaints have been registered about this call yet.

newComplaint.needCustomers: You need access to customers to register complaints.
newComplaint.customerHint: Search by name, phone, email or org. no. If the customer does not exist, create it under Customers first.
newComplaint.saleHint: The sale the complaint concerns, if it concerns a sale. Its documentation is brought into the case.
newComplaint.description: What is the customer complaining about?
newComplaint.descriptionHint: Optional. Repeat the customer’s own words as closely as you can.
newComplaint.customerOptionalHint: The customer may only be in the call centre's own system. Choose the customer here if they are in VeriQall.
newComplaint.descriptionCallHint: Paste the customer's own words. The AI assesses the complaint against what was said in the call.

detail.docHidden: You do not have access to this sale. Sales that are not yours or your team’s require access to all calls and signing in with BankID or a passkey.
detail.outcomeHint: What was decided, and why. This is the answer the case can be referred to later.
detail.newNoteHint: Notes cannot be edited or deleted afterwards.
detail.noCustomer: Not registered (the complaint is about the call)
detail.callHidden: You do not have access to the call. Other sellers' calls require access to all calls and signing in with BankID or a passkey.
detail.callGone: The call was deleted at the end of its retention period. The reference is still on the case.
detail.linkCallIntro: Fetch the call the complaint is about with the reference from the sales system. Then you can listen to the recording, read the transcript and get the AI's assessment.
detail.link: Link the complaint to this call
detail.complaintTextHint: Paste the customer's own words, for example from the e-mail. The AI assesses the complaint against what was said in the call.

assessment.title: Assessment of the complaint
assessment.intro: The AI compares the complaint with the transcript and the note, point by point. Listen to the recording before you decide the case.
assessment.needCall: Link the complaint to the call first.
assessment.working: The AI is assessing the complaint …

verdict.not_justified: The call does not support the complaint
verdict.unclear: The call does not settle it

assessment.changed: The complaint has changed since this assessment. Assess again to include the change.

reply.title: Draft reply
reply.intro: The AI drafts a reply to the customer based on the complaint, the assessment and the call. Read it, adjust it and send it from your own e-mail.
reply.instructionsHint: For example “Reject the complaint, but offer to cancel the agreement without a fee”. The AI promises nothing you do not write here.
reply.working: The AI is writing the draft …
reply.placeholders: Replace the fields in square brackets, such as the customer's name and your name, before you send it.
